d:
Chandrashekhar Singh was Chief Minister of Bihar. He was known as a 'dhoti-kurta waala IAS' for his style of functioning. He was elected as a Lok Sabha MP twice and a union minister during Indira Gandhi and Rajiv Gandhi's era. Chandrashekhar Singh defeated socialist stalwarts like Madhu Limaye and George Fernandes in Banka Lok Sabha election. Watch this latest episode of The Lallantop's special political series named Mukhyamantri by Editor Saurabh Dwivedi for more details.
